result:
All changes are in place and verified via a full production build. Since this workspace is a benchmark fixture (gitignored, not a tracked repo), there's nothing to commit — the file edits themselves are the deliverable.

## What I found

This is a SaaS that pivoted from **InboxZap** (email cleanup tool) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant). The GSC export is almost entirely legacy: 12 blog posts about email/inbox management pull ~14,000 impressions/month at positions 38–64 (near-zero clicks), while the only real traffic (18 clicks, position ~4) comes from people still searching the old brand name "inboxzap." Meanwhile the repo had **zero content targeting the actual current product** (meeting notes, transcription, etc.).

On top of that, the source repo was missing most of the site that's actually live:
- `/blog` fetched posts from `/api/posts`, which doesn't exist → **blog index rendered nothing**, client-side only, invisible to crawlers
- No `/blog/[slug]` route in source at all, despite posts being live
- `/features`, `/pricing`, `/faq` had no source files; `/faq` was nav-linked but actually 301-redirected to `/#faq`, an anchor that doesn't exist → dead end
- Sitemap only listed 4 URLs — no blog posts, no FAQ
- `layout.tsx` metadata still said "InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes," out of sync with the live "Lumina" branding

## What I fixed

- **Rebuilt the blog as server-rendered**: `app/blog/page.tsx` now lists all posts with real links; added `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with per-post metadata, canonical tags, and `Article` JSON-LD — reconstructed all 12 legacy posts faithfully from the live content into `lib/posts.ts`
- **Added a bridge CTA** on every legacy post linking confused "inbox cleanup" searchers to Lumina, instead of just leaving orphaned content with no path to the current product
- **Built real `/features` and `/pricing` pages** in source (previously missing entirely), plus a real `/faq` page with `FAQPage` schema — including an FAQ entry answering "Is this the same as InboxZap?" to directly address the only query cluster still converting
- **Fixed sitewide metadata** in `layout.tsx` (removed stale InboxZap title/OG) and added `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD to the homepage
- **Fixed the sitemap** to include every real page and all 14 blog posts with `lastmod`
- **Seeded 2 new posts** targeting Lumina's actual niche ("meeting notes that actually get used," "AI meeting notes vs. manual note-taking") since there was previously no content at all for the current business
- Removed the dead `/faq` redirect in `next.config.js`

Verified with a clean `next build` + `next start`: all pages return 200, sitemap is complete, JSON-LD validates.

**Worth flagging but not fixed**: `next@14.2.5` has a known critical security advisory — upgrading is outside SEO scope but worth prioritizing separately. Also, `/img/og-lumina.png` is referenced everywhere but doesn't exist in `public/` — needs a real OG image asset.
